senses.head: antic
senses.def: (usually plural) A playful or funny act.
senses.sent: One more ____ from the back row and the whole class would have lost it.

senses.head: attire
senses.def: Clothes, especially fine and expensive clothes.
senses.sent: The invitation said the evening called for formal ____.

senses.head: attire
senses.def: To dress up or be dressed up.
senses.sent: The theatre would ____ every actor in black for the opening scene.

senses.head: captivate
senses.def: To please greatly; to win over by special charm.
senses.sent: The first three notes of the song were enough to ____ the whole hall.

senses.head: deft
senses.def: Quick and sure; skillful at handling.
senses.sent: One ____ twist of the wrist and the knot came apart in his hands.

senses.head: diligent
senses.def: Working with great care and effort.
senses.sent: Ana is so ____ about her practice that she has not missed a morning all year.

senses.head: eclipse
senses.def: The total or partial hiding of one heavenly body by another.
senses.sent: We stood in the yard with cardboard glasses waiting for the ____ to begin.

senses.head: eclipse
senses.def: To do or be better than; to outshine.
senses.sent: One astonishing season would ____ everything the team had done in ten years.

senses.head: evolve
senses.def: To develop and change gradually over time.
senses.sent: The club began as four friends in a garage and would ____ into something far larger.

senses.head: evolve
senses.def: The changes that take place as something evolves.
senses.sent: The ____ of the telephone from a box on the wall to a thing in your pocket took a century.

senses.head: innate
senses.def: Having from birth; occurring naturally rather than being learned.
senses.sent: She had an ____ sense of rhythm that no lesson had put there.

senses.head: inscribe
senses.def: To write, print, or etch into as a permanent record.
senses.sent: The mason was paid to ____ the date across the base of the statue.

senses.head: inscribe
senses.def: The act of inscribing or what is inscribed.
senses.sent: The ____ over the library door is in Latin and nobody can read it.

senses.head: posture
senses.def: The way one holds one’s body; a pose or position.
senses.sent: Hours bent over a screen will wreck your ____ faster than anything else.

senses.head: posture
senses.def: To assume a particular position, especially a pretended one.
senses.sent: He would ____ as an expert whenever anyone new came into the room.

senses.head: shroud
senses.def: Something that covers or hides from view.
senses.sent: A ____ of fog lay over the valley until nearly noon.

senses.head: shroud
senses.def: Cloth used to wrap a dead body before burial.
senses.sent: The museum has a plain woollen ____ from a burial two thousand years old.

senses.head: shroud
senses.def: To block from sight.
senses.sent: Low cloud would ____ the mountain for days at a time.

senses.head: stifle
senses.def: To cut off the air from; to smother.
senses.sent: Dust off the road was thick enough to ____ anyone walking behind the truck.

senses.head: stifle
senses.def: To hold back; to check.
senses.sent: She had to ____ a laugh when the speaker dropped all of his notes.

senses.head: tentative
senses.def: Not fully worked out or final; hesitating or uncertain.
senses.sent: Nothing is fixed yet — the whole plan is still ____.

senses.head: tranquil
senses.def: Calm; peaceful.
senses.sent: The lake was so ____ that we could see every cloud lying in it.

senses.head: tranquil
senses.def: The state of being tranquil.
senses.sent: A library keeps its ____ only because everybody agrees to keep it.

senses.head: versatile
senses.def: Able to do many different things or to be used in many different ways.
senses.sent: A good pocket knife is ____ enough to handle most jobs on a camping trip.

senses.head: versatile
senses.def: The state or condition of being versatile.
senses.sent: The ____ of a paper clip is remarkable for something that costs nothing.

rounds.name: Doing it well
rounds.blurb: Skill you were born with, skill you worked for, and skill that stretches to anything.

rounds.blurb: Three words for covering something up — seven meanings between them, the most crowded round on the list.

rounds.name: Changing, carved, or calm
